title: 大型科學設施超高真空工程
titleEn: Large Research Facility Ultra High Vacuum Engineering
summary: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與轉換
stages.description: 單元1–2：超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速
stages.descriptionEn: Units 1–2: Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed
stages.route: 依序完成機制、估算、驗證與診斷；這是學習路徑，不是現場操作順序。
stages.routeEn: Complete mechanism, estimate, verification and diagnosis as a learning path, not an operating sequence.

steps.title: 單元1｜真空穩態壓力：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Steady vacuum pressure: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」。畫出「氣體負荷 → 腔體 → 導通管路 → 泵浦 → 壓力感測」並圈出與「真空穩態壓力」有關的介面。將 load/speed 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：穩態壓力近似為氣體負荷除腔體有效抽速。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed. Draw Gas load → Chamber → Conductance path → Pump → Pressure sensing and mark the interfaces relevant to Steady vacuum pressure. Place every variable of load/speed on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Steady pressure is approximately gas load divided by effective chamber pumping speed. Identify what it cannot establish: Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 對照「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.

Model inputs and field measurements need not be distinguished.
Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.

steps.title: 單元1｜真空穩態壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Steady vacuum pressure: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」的「真空穩態壓力」採以下合成教學值：load=1e-06 Pa m³/s；speed=0.01 m³/s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 load/speed；獨立基準為 0.0001 Pa。把 load 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 0.00011 Pa。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, use synthetic inputs for Steady vacuum pressure: load=1e-06 Pa m³/s；speed=0.01 m³/s. Check dimensions before evaluating load/speed; the independent benchmark is 0.0001 Pa. Increase load by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 0.00011 Pa. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: load增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 1e-05 Pa。管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 1e-05 Pa. Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.
steps.check: 原值重算與 0.0001 Pa 相符；10%案例與 0.00011 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 0.0001 Pa at baseline and 0.00011 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（Pa）？
quiz.explanation: 按 load/speed 逐項代入，結果為 0.0001；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into load/speed gives 0.0001; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜真空穩態壓力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Steady vacuum pressure: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」設計「真空穩態壓力」的獨立驗證：以數位壓升曲線區分常數漏入與隨時間衰減的放氣項。 以合成壓升、抽氣曲線和空白腔體分開漏入、放氣及感測零偏。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, independently verify Steady vacuum pressure: Use digital pressure-rise traces to distinguish constant leaks from decaying outgassing. Use synthetic pressure-rise, pumpdown and blank-chamber data to separate leaks, outgassing and bias. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「管路導通會降低有效抽速；啟動瞬態及放氣時間變化另處理。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Line conductance reduces effective speed; pumpdown transients and time-varying outgassing require separate treatment.

只保留最後的通過字樣。

optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Use digital pressure-rise traces to distinguish constant leaks from decaying outgassing.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.title: 單元1｜真空穩態壓力：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Steady vacuum pressure: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」。以本單元「真空穩態壓力」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以數位壓升曲線區分常數漏入與隨時間衰減的放氣項。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed. For Steady vacuum pressure, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Use digital pressure-rise traces to distinguish constant leaks from decaying outgassing. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」的「名義停留時間」採以下合成教學值：volume=0.02 m³；flow=0.001 m³/s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 volume/flow；獨立基準為 20 s。把 volume 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 22 s。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, use synthetic inputs for Nominal residence time: volume=0.02 m³；flow=0.001 m³/s. Check dimensions before evaluating volume/flow; the independent benchmark is 20 s. Increase volume by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 22 s. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: volume增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 2 s。不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 2 s. This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 原值重算與 20 s 相符；10%案例與 22 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 20 s at baseline and 22 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（s）？
quiz.explanation: 按 volume/flow 逐項代入，結果為 20；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into volume/flow gives 20; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜名義停留時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Nominal residence time: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」設計「名義停留時間」的獨立驗證：以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。 以合成壓升、抽氣曲線和空白腔體分開漏入、放氣及感測零偏。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed, independently verify Nominal residence time: Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q. Use synthetic pressure-rise, pumpdown and blank-chamber data to separate leaks, outgassing and bias. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.

steps.title: 單元2｜名義停留時間：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Nominal residence time: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」。以本單元「名義停留時間」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed. For Nominal residence time, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速」不是單靠 20 s 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 20 s alone cannot exclude Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 泵浦名義抽速代表腔體有效抽速；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Nominal pump speed treated as chamber effective speed; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「超高真空的漏率、放氣與有效抽速」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Leak rate, outgassing and effective pumping speed and retaining failed cases.
